people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
translations.bsb: And when he saw one of them being mistreated, Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him.
